name: writers-read-only-feedback
body:
Plan-writers, spec-writers, and implementers must hold no feedback-action capability: `apg_review_action` (and `apg_review_resolve`/`apg_review_reject`) is not granted to them, so a dispatched writer cannot move a feedback item's state. Each holds a read-only feedback channel (`apg_review`) and responds to the single item it was given with an ACTIONED or WONT-FIX claim returned to the coordinator — never by calling an action command.

Acceptance: none of the spec-writer, plan-writer, or implementer agent grants (the distributed suite templates and this repo's generated agents) includes `apg_review_action`; each includes the read-only feedback channel; the agent-builder template states the same grant shape for the writers it scaffolds.
